rci1_using_msad.detail: Three separate normative models each trained on single-site HCs: Discovery (UCLA CNP), Validation 1 (COBRE), Validation 2 (DIRECT site 20). DIRECT site 20 was explicitly selected as a single site to avoid multi-site effects.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset was obtained from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP)"; "The validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)"; "The single-site dataset with the largest sample size (site 20) was used to prevent multi-site effects on the results."
rci1_using_msad.location: Fang2024.pdf.md: 2.1. Datasets, L72-L80; Fang2024_sup.docx.md: Supplementary methods / Datasets

rci2_using_epd.detail: COBRE dataset (an established public dataset) used as reference cohort for validation dataset 1 normative model. UCLA CNP (OpenfMRI) is publicly available but not on the confirmed EPD list.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) and is available at http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html"

rci3_epd_name.detail: COBRE HCs (n=73) used for normative model training in validation dataset 1; UCLA CNP and DIRECT site 20 are not on the confirmed EPD list
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) and is available at http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; Gaussian process regression model trained on HCs within each dataset separately; N values from Table S1 (after exclusions). All HCs used for NM training (no train/test split of HCs reported).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes (GMVs) based on age and sex in HCs"; Table S1: "HC (n = 110)", "HC (n = 73)", "HC (N=251)"
rci5_n.location: Fang2024.pdf.md: 2.2. Subtyping analysis, L82-L84; Fang2024_sup.docx.md: Table S1

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; male % reported in Table S1; female_n estimated as total N minus male_n; male_n estimated from reported male % (model-1: 110×78.38%≈86, slight rounding discrepancy as 86/110=78.2%; model-2: 73×68.49%=50, exact; model-3: 251×34.66%=87, exact)
rci6_sex.supporting_text: Table S1: HC (n=110) Sex (male %) 78.38%; HC (n=73) Sex (male %) 68.49%; HC (N=251) Sex (male %) 34.66%
